g.text: 1 manifest passes on the new code
Datadog evidence fields were removed, renamed or changed meaning
Re-check validators that read Datadog fields; a failed page now gives null counts
paramify update brings your clone up to date, and checks it first
Follows main or a pinned release, and tells you which of your fetchers change
paramify status shows what each fetcher has in Paramify
Evidence set, artifact count and validators for every fetcher in a manifest
GitHub, Oracle Cloud, Qualys and Sophos categories
Over fifty new fetchers, plus many more for Azure
paramify upload --plan shows what an upload would do
Reads the workspace and changes nothing; uploads now go out as batches
The TUI tells you when an update is waiting, and applies it
Press U for the plan paramify update shows; apply it or roll back from there
GitHub credentials evidence no longer needs Secrets read
Actions secret names and ages are collected only when the token has that grant
2 other breaking changes that don't touch you
